messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary rollout id=canary-427 failed: 6/10 pods CrashLoopBackOff in namespace inference-canary. Automated pause applied. See logs: https://logs.redwood/canary-427

sam_oncall: paging oncall — ack?

alex.sre: acked. jumping in to triage.

maria.platform: seeing crashloops with init container exiting 1. liveness probe is fine, it never gets there.

ben_ops: logs from init: `error: open /etc/secrets/new-auth.json: no such file or directory`

alex.sre: that secret name is `new-auth-key`. The manifest references it in the init container mount, but I don't see it in the canary ns.

maria.platform: the CD job that creates the secret should have run during the deploy. looks like the step skipped for canary due to a predicate in the pipeline (changed by recent pipeline tweak).

gina_cs: CS reporting user-facing 502/503s for a set of EU customers — they match canary traffic only (we routed 10% EU to canary).

sam_oncall: impact estimate: ~2.1% global request error rate increase, concentrated in canary-backed endpoints. Not wide blast, but customer-visible.

alex.sre: quick mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag that enables the init behaviour so canary uses old path, 2) scale down the canary replica set entirely so traffic drops, 3) patch mount/secret (pain during live rollout). Preferred: flip kill-switch + scale down.

maria.platform: agreed. flipping FF now: `ffctl set inference.new-init false --env=prod-canary --actor=maria.platform`  (runbook: Canary Init Failure -> Kill-switch)

maria.platform: done — API confirms toggle.

deploy-bot: Feature flag toggle recorded by runbook (actor=maria.platform). Notifying rollout controller to stop canary traffic.

ben_ops: scaling replica set to 0 to stop churn: `kubectl scale rs canary-new-init-5bd4 --replicas=0 -n inference-canary` — executed.

alex.sre: within ~30s after scale down + FF toggle, crashloops dropped to 0 and 5xxs returned to baseline.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by sam_oncall. Pager duty: P2 -> mitigated state updated.

sam_oncall: handing off monitoring and post-incident steps. Will prepare a short incident note and RCA stub. @jordan you are night oncall — I'll handoff in 10m.

gina_cs: sending customer ACKs now to affected accounts with mitigation note.

alex.sre: preliminary root cause: CD pipeline change caused secret creation to skip for canary namespace; new init container had no defensive fallback when secret missing. HPA scaled some helpers up due to metric noise but wasn't the primary cause.

maria.platform: immediate action items: create CD gate to assert secret exists before promoting canary manifest; add lint in pipeline to fail-fast if manifest requires a secret that doesn't exist; add defensive behavior to init container so it doesn't hard-fail without the secret (fallback to no-op). I'll create tasks and assign to platform-team.

sam_oncall: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/canary-init-failures. I'll append timeline + commands run.

alex.sre: we should also add an automated pre-check in rollout controller to verify non-empty mounts are present in target ns for canary. Filing as follow-up.

jordan: acknowledged takeover, monitoring. please paste logs/links + any pending runs in the incident note if you leave.

sam_oncall: last update before handoff: mitigated, customer impact contained, kill-switch + scale down applied, follow-ups opened (CD gate, init defensive logic, rollout pre-check). handing off to @jordan.
